witnesses.exact_text: وَعَنْ  عَطَاءٍ: نَزَلَتْ فِي أَبِي لَهَبٍ، وَذَلِكَ حِينَ مَاتَ ابْنُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَهَبَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَقَالَ: بُتِرَ مُحَمَّدٌ اللَّيْلَةَ. فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ: ﴿إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأبْتَرُ﴾
witnesses.boundary_note: Ends immediately before the separate Ibn Abbas/Abu Jahl attribution.

witnesses.exact_text:
It has been reported that `Ata' said, "This Surah was revealed about Abu Lahab when a son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died. Abu Lahab went to the idolators and said, `Muhammad has been cut off (i.e., from progeny) tonight.' So concerning this Allah revealed,
إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الاٌّبْتَرُ
(For he who hates you, he will be cut off.)"
witnesses.boundary_note: Ends immediately before the separate al-Suddi report.

fidelity_findings: Both witnesses attribute the report to Ata and identify Abu Lahab.
Both preserve the death of a son of the Messenger of Allah and Abu Lahab's statement that Muhammad was cut off that night.
The English parenthetical (i.e., from progeny) is an explanatory gloss absent from the Arabic span.
The English explicitly introduces the attribution as a report; neither exact span supplies an isnad.
